description: This file contains deterministic, non-AI data processing functions for Agentic RAG, including text chunking, keyword extraction, embedding, similarity calculations, and related utilities.

methods.name: load_document
methods.description: Loads a document from a specified file path.

methods.name: create_chunk_id
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for a text chunk based on its content and index.

methods.name: simple_chunk_text
methods.description: Splits text into overlapping chunks with sentence boundary consideration.

methods.name: extract_keywords
methods.description: Extracts top N keywords from text based on frequency, excluding common stop words.

methods.name: keyword_match_score
methods.description: Calculates the proportion of query keywords present in a chunk of text.

methods.name: cosine_similarity
methods.description: Calculates cosine similarity between two vectors.

methods.name: find_quote_in_chunk
methods.description: Finds the most relevant sentence in a chunk that matches a claim.

methods.name: deduplicate_chunks
methods.description: Removes duplicate text chunks based on normalized text similarity.

methods.name: embed_text
methods.description: Embeds a single text string into a vector using an embedding manager.

methods.name: embed_batch
methods.description: Embeds multiple texts efficiently in batch.

methods.name: compute_similarity
methods.description: Computes cosine similarity between two embedding vectors.

methods.name: rank_by_similarity
methods.description: Ranks chunks by similarity to a query embedding, returning top K matches.
